messages:
liam: Noticed another SDK vs REST parity issue — Node SDK doesn't send the `priority` routing hint and defaults to normal, while our REST examples show `priority: \"high\"` for low-latency routes. On Dedicated customers this causes requests to land in the slower pool.

liam: Repro (curl that routes to fast pool):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"x","priority":"high"}'
```

liam: Starter-kit-node does: `client.generate({ prompt: 'x' })` only. There's no arg for priority in client options or per-request headers.

nina: Hmm we intentionally kept routing hints out of SDK surface to avoid tenant abuse, but forgot the Dedicated use-case where customers rely on `priority` to hit reserved pools. That is a miss.

jorge: Agreed. SDK should expose a safe enum for routing: `priority: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high'` and validate. We should also map header-based flow (X-Redwood-Priority) to payload for parity.

liam: Another wrinkle: when auth refresh happens (401->refresh->retry) the SDK retry path replays the request but omits any ephemeral routing headers. So even if we add param support via headers, retries will lose them. Saw this with a customer who toggles aggressive refresh.

nina: Sounds like two fixes: (1) add explicit per-request `priority` option in SDK and serialize into payload (safe), (2) fix refresh/redo path to preserve request-level metadata/headers.

jorge: Proposed coarse plan: a) SDK change to add `options.priority` defaulting to undefined (no change unless set), b) map `priority` to both JSON payload key and `X-Redwood-Priority` header for backwards compatibility, c) write unit + integration test against Dedicated routing in staging.

ops: Ops note: if we start allowing `priority` in SDK, rate limits and abuse thresholds need to be enforced server-side. Ops will gate rollout with feature-flag and monitor QPS from SDK+priority.

liam: For immediate workaround, add `X-Redwood-Priority` header in starter-kit Node's request pipeline as a customHeader and string-set `priority` in payload manually. Example patch: `client.generate({ prompt, priority: 'high' }, { customHeaders: { 'X-Redwood-Priority': 'high' } })` (until SDK exposes it).

nina: I'll open an RFC PR describing the safe SDK surface and server-side checks. Include telemetry plan: count requests with priority set and drop-rate if abused.

jorge: I'll implement SDK change and add tests. Also fix token refresh path to deep-clone and copy `options.customHeaders` / `metadata` so routing hints survive retries.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for branch/sdk/priority-param -> staging build 2026.03.23.112. Running routing conformance tests.

liam: Thanks. Adding a quick note to starter-kit README so new Dedicated customers don't get confused while we roll this out.
